notes.title: Panic Porcupine 1.07 Update!
notes.notes:
We've released a new version of Panic Porcupine with several quality of life improvements.

* Full Options Menu is now accessible from within levels/map screens
* Menu system improvements
* New tutorial videos that give hints on tricky sections in first world
* Switching to Portuguese in the menu works now
* Performance improvements
* Various small level polish improvements
* Minor bug fixes
